entities.summary: Count Ian Melcher Shering Wachtmeister af Johannishus was a Swedish industrialist and politician. He was a member of the Swedish Riksdag from 1991 to 1994. He was the son of Count Ted Wachtmeister and Adrienne, née De Geer.
